agents.name: orchestrator
agents.purpose: Tech lead. Classifies the request and delegates specialized work.

agents.name: planner
agents.purpose: Requirements, spec, ADR, and task plan. Does not implement.

agents.name: implementer
agents.purpose: Implements one specified task and reports the diff.
agents.recommended_for: A single task with a spec and verification.

agents.name: tester
agents.purpose: Writes and runs tests and evals. Reports objective evidence.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.purpose: Independent review against requirements, spec, and tests.
agents.recommended_for: After tests pass on a non-trivial change.

agents.name: debugger
agents.purpose: Reproduces a failure and finds the root cause before a fix.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.purpose: Independent security review with stack references. Reports SEC findings; does not fix.
agents.recommended_for: Security risk HIGH or CRITICAL, sensitive surfaces, or /security-review.

agents.name: designer
agents.purpose: Decides the visual identity with the user: design brief, three rendered directions, DESIGN.md and tokens. Writes no production code.
agents.recommended_for: A new visual interface without an approved DESIGN.md.

agents.name: frontend-implementer
agents.purpose: Implements one screen bound to DESIGN.md and the tokens, with every state and the anti-slop lint clean.
agents.recommended_for: A UI task once DESIGN.md is approved.

agents.name: design-reviewer
agents.purpose: Independent design review against DESIGN.md, the brief, and the lint. Reports FIND findings; does not fix.
agents.recommended_for: After a screen is built, before delivery.
